senses.gloss:
फेन फेन or फेण, अस्, अम्, m. n. (said to
be fr. फे, substituted for rt. स्फाय्, Uṇādi-s. III. 3;
by some derived fr. rt. फण्), foam, froth, spume;
scum [cf. दुग्ध-फ्˚, पयः-फेनी]; foam of
the mouth, moisture of the lips, saliva [cf. वृषली-
फेन-पीत, फणि-फ्˚]; (अस्), m. white cuttle-fish
bone, os sepiæ, supposed to be indurated foam of
the sea [cf. अब्धि-कफ, अब्धि-फ्˚, समुद्र-
फ्˚]; N. of a son of Ushad-ratha and father of
Su-tapas; (आ), f. a species of shrub, = सातला;
(ई), f. a kind of food; [cf. Lat. spūma;
Angl. Sax. fam, fœman; Slav. pêna, ‘foam.’]
—फेन-गिरि, इस्, m., N. of a mountain near the
mouth of the Indus; (also written फेण-गिरि.)
—फेन-ता, f. frothiness, vapour.
—फेन-दुग्धा,
f. a kind of small shrub (= दुग्ध-फेनी).
—फे-
न-प, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘froth-drinking, foam-quaffing,’
feeding on foam; (according to a Scholiast = स्वयम्
[]
पतितैः फलादिभिर् जीवन्; also spelt फेण-
प.)
—फेन-पिण्ड, अस्, m. ‘a mass of foam,’ a
mere bubble, any mere fancy, empty idea, nonentity,
nonsense.
—फेन-प्रख्य, अस्, आ, अम्, foam-like,
resembling foam.
—फेन-मेहिन्, ई, इनी, इ, dis-
charging frothy urine.
—फेन-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
frothy, foaming, bubbling.
—फेन-वाहिन्, ई, m.
‘carrying off the scum,’ a filtering cloth; ‘foam-
bearing,’ (perhaps) the thunderbolt of Indra (Indra
having used the foam of the sea for his thunderbolt
to kill the demon Vṛtra); (perhaps rather) an epi-
thet of Indra; [cf. फेनाशनि.]
—फेनाग्र (˚न-
अग्˚), अम्, n. ‘surface of foam,’ a bubble on the
water.
—फेनाशनि (˚न-अश्˚), इस्, m. ‘having foam
for a thunderbolt,’ an epithet of Indra.
—फेनाहार
(˚न-आह्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, living on foam, feeding on
froth.
—फेनोपम (˚न-उप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, foam-
like, resembling foam (said of life).

फेनक, अस्, m. white cuttle-fish bone, os sepiæ;
(अस्, आ), m. f. a kind of pastry; ground rice boiled
in water; the soap-berry?; (इका), f. a kind of pre-
pared food; froth.
फेनल, अस्, आ, अम्, frothy, foamy; [cf. फेनिल.]

फेनाय, Nom. A. फेनायते, -यितुम्, to foam,
froth.
फेनायमान, अस्, आ, अम्, foaming, frothing.

फेनिल, अस्, आ, अम्, foamy, frothy, spumous;
(अस्), m. the soap plant, Sapindus Detergens; the
plant Zizyphus Jujuba, = बदर; (आ), f. a species of
plant (= बाम्ब, बाम्बी, जल-ब्रह्मी, सर्पाक्षी);
the plant Sapindus Detergens; (अम्), n. (probably)
the fruit of Sapindus Detergens; the fruit of Zizyphus
Jujuba; the fruit of Madana.

फेन्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. existing in foam;
(Mahī-dhara) = डिण्डिरे भवः.
